manifest: SHA256-MANIFEST.json is excluded from its own hash because its content depends on manifest rows.
terminal_receipt: terminal_manifest.receipt.json is created by unchanged runner only AFTER child writes final manifest; absent/uncompleted at hash snapshot, explicitly excluded.
terminal_output: terminal_manifest.output.txt is created after final child exits; absent/uncompleted at hash snapshot, explicitly excluded.
terminal_resource_coverage: terminal_manifest receipt is authoritative terminal resource record; resource-inventory.json snapshot predates preterminal_audit and terminal_manifest, both accounted in SHA manifest if completed at snapshot. No circular attestation.
postcondition: No more substantive local commands after terminal_manifest. frozen-after is hashed by terminal snapshot. All previously completed receipt JSONs, including bootstrap and preterminal_audit, hashed.
